### Rydde dataene

```{r}
#| label: rydd-data
rydd_pend <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      akom_navn = arbeidsstedskommune,
      bkom_navn = bostedskommune,
      akom = paste("k", ArbstedKomm, sep = ""),
      bkom = paste("k", Bokommuen, sep = ""),
      # Skifter nummer for Etne og Sveio
      akom = ifelse(akom == "k1211", "k4611", akom),
      akom = ifelse(akom == "k1216", "k4612", akom),
      bkom = ifelse(bkom == "k1211", "k4611", bkom),
      bkom = ifelse(bkom == "k1216", "k4612", bkom),
      # Skifter navn for Etne og Sveio
      akom_navn = ifelse(akom_navn == "Etne (-2019)", "Etne", akom_navn),
      akom_navn = ifelse(akom_navn == "Sveio (-2019)", "Sveio", akom_navn),
      bkom_navn = ifelse(bkom_navn == "Etne (-2019)", "Etne", bkom_navn),
      bkom_navn = ifelse(bkom_navn == "Sveio (-2019)", "Sveio", bkom_navn)
    ) %>%
    rename(aar = Tid, pendlere = value) %>%
    select(aar, akom, akom_navn, bkom, bkom_navn, pendlere) %>%
    as_tibble()
}

pend_02_25_boBF  <- rydd_pend(pend_02_25_ssb_boBF)
pend_02_25_arbBF <- rydd_pend(pend_02_25_ssb_arbBF)
```

```{r}
#| label: sjekk-rydd
print(pend_02_25_boBF, n = 5)   
print(pend_02_25_arbBF, n = 5)  
```

## Kommunesammenslåingene

```{r}
#| label: knr-u-SSV
knr_u_SSV <- paste(
  "k",
  c(
    1124, 1127, 1120, 1122, 1121, 1119, 1144, 1130, 1106, 1146, 1149, 1145, 1133,
    1134, 1135, 1102, 4611, 4612
  ),
  sep = ""
)
```

### Bosted rundt Boknafjorden

```{r}
#| label: nye-kom-boBF
pend_02_25_boBF <- pend_02_25_boBF %>%
  mutate(
    nye_bkom = case_when(
      bkom %in% c("k1102", "k1108", "k1129") ~ "k1108",
      bkom %in% c("k1103", "k1141", "k1142") ~ "k1103",
      bkom %in% c("k1154", "k1159", "k1160") ~ "k1160",
      TRUE ~ bkom
    ),
    nye_bkom_navn = case_when(
      bkom %in% c("k1102", "k1108", "k1129") ~ "Sandnes",
      bkom %in% c("k1103", "k1141", "k1142") ~ "Stavanger",
      bkom %in% c("k1154", "k1159", "k1160") ~ "Vindafjord",
      TRUE ~ bkom_navn
    ),
    nye_akom = case_when(
      akom %in% c("k1102", "k1108", "k1129") ~ "k1108",
      akom %in% c("k1103", "k1141", "k1142") ~ "k1103",
      akom %in% c("k1154", "k1159", "k1160") ~ "k1160",
      akom %in% knr_u_SSV ~ akom,
      TRUE ~ "k9999"                       
    ),
    nye_akom_navn = case_when(
      akom %in% c("k1102", "k1108", "k1129") ~ "Sandnes",
      akom %in% c("k1103", "k1141", "k1142") ~ "Stavanger",
      akom %in% c("k1154", "k1159", "k1160") ~ "Vindafjord",
      akom %in% knr_u_SSV ~ akom_navn,
      TRUE ~ "RAL"
    )
  )

pend_02_25_boBF_agg <- pend_02_25_boBF %>%
  group_by(aar, nye_akom, nye_akom_navn, nye_bkom, nye_bkom_navn) %>%
  summarise(pendlere = sum(pendlere), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(nye_akom, nye_bkom, aar)
```

```{r}
#| label: sjekk-boBF-agg
print(pend_02_25_boBF_agg, n = 24)   
pend_02_25_boBF_agg |> distinct(nye_bkom) |> pull(nye_bkom)
pend_02_25_boBF_agg |> distinct(nye_akom) |> pull(nye_akom)
```

## Totalt antall arbeidstakere i hele landet per år

```{r}
#| label: fnr
fnr <- c(
  "30", "01", "02", "06", "03", "34", "04", "05", "38",
  "07", "08", "42", "09", "10", "11", "46", "12", "14",
  "15", "50", "16", "17", "18", "54", "19", "20", "31",
  "32", "33", "39", "40", "55", "56"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: info-11616
#| eval: false
ApiData(
  "https://data.ssb.no/api/v0/no/table/11616",
  returnApiQuery = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: hent-11616
#| cache: true
arb_HL_ssb <- ApiData12(
  urlToData = "11616",
  Region = fnr,
  Kjonn  = TRUE,
  Alder  = TRUE,
  ContentsCode = TRUE,
  Tid    = as.character(2002:2025)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: sjekk-11616
arb_HL_ssb |>
  select(-value, -Region, -Tid) |>
  select(where(is.character)) |>
  map(unique)

arb_HL_ssb |>
  filter(Tid == "2002") |>
  group_by(Kjonn, Alder, ContentsCode) |>
  summarise(sum_2002 = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
#| label: tot-arb-HL
tot_arb_HL <- arb_HL_ssb |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(
    ContentsCode == "Bosatt",
    Alder == "15-74"
  ) |>
  group_by(aar = Tid) |>
  summarise(arbtak_HL = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(arbtak_HL = as.integer(round(arbtak_HL)))

print(tot_arb_HL)   
```

### Bor i Bokna-regionen jobber HL

```{r}
#| label: bBFjHL
BF <- c(knr_u_SSV, "k1103", "k1108", "k1160")

bBFjHL <- pend_02_25 %>%
  filter(bkom %in% BF) %>%
  group_by(aar) %>%
  summarise(bBFjHL = sum(pendlere))
```

### Bor i RAL jobber i Bokna-regionen

```{r}
#| label: bRALjBF
bRALjBF <- pend_02_25 %>%
  filter(bkom == "k9999", akom %in% BF) %>%
  group_by(aar) %>%
  summarise(bRALjBF = sum(pendlere))

tot_arb_HL <- left_join(tot_arb_HL, bBFjHL, by = join_by(aar))
tot_arb_HL <- left_join(tot_arb_HL, bRALjBF, by = join_by(aar))

tot_arb_HL <- tot_arb_HL |>
  mutate(bRALjRAL = arbtak_HL - bBFjHL - bRALjBF)

print(tot_arb_HL)   
```

```{r}
#| label: total-og-RAL
total <- tot_arb_HL %>%
  select(aar, pendlere = arbtak_HL) %>%
  mutate(
    akom = "k0000",
    akom_navn = "TotaltBo",
    bkom = "k0000",
    bkom_navn = "TotaltArb",
    .before = pendlere
  )

p_bRALjRAL <- tot_arb_HL |>
  transmute(
    aar,
    akom = "k9999", akom_navn = "RAL",
    bkom = "k9999", bkom_navn = "RAL",
    pendlere = as.integer(bRALjRAL)
  )

print(p_bRALjRAL, n = 5)

pend_02_25 <- bind_rows(pend_02_25, p_bRALjRAL)

```

### Foreløpig pendlematrise for 2010

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pend2010
#| tbl-cap: "Pendlematrise for 2010 for Boknafjord-regionen. k9999 er resten av landet."
pend_02_25 |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(aar == "2010") |>
  select(bkom, akom, pendlere) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = akom, values_from = pendlere) |>
  as_flextable(max_row = 30, show_coltype = FALSE) |>
  fontsize(size = 5, part = "all") |>
  line_spacing(space = 0.3, part = "all") |>
  colformat_int(big.mark = " ") |>
  set_table_properties(width = 0.15, layout = "autofit") |>
  padding(padding = 3) |>
  delete_part("footer")
```

pendle_data_02_25 <- bind_rows(pend_02_25, totalt_arb, totalt_bo, total) |>

## Andel pendlere

```{r}
#| label: andeler
andel_pendle_data_02_25 <- pendle_data_02_25 %>%
  unite(knrN, akom, akom_navn) %>%
  group_by(aar, bkom, bkom_navn) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = knrN, values_from = pendlere) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = k1103_Stavanger:k0000_TotaltBo,
      .fns = function(x) round((x / k0000_TotaltBo) * 100, digits = 4)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(andel_pendle_data_02_25)   
names(andel_pendle_data_02_25)
```
```{r}
#| label: tbl-andel2017
#| tbl-cap: "Pendlematrise som viser andelen av arbeidsstyrken som pendler til ulike kommuner, 2017."
tab <- andel_pendle_data_02_25 |>
  filter(aar == 2017) |>
  select(-aar, -bkom_navn)

names(tab) <- str_replace_all(names(tab), "_", "\n")

tab |>
  as_flextable(show_coltype = FALSE, max_row = 30) |>
  rotate(rotation = "tbrl", part = "header") |>
  line_spacing(space = 0.5, part = "body") |>
  colformat_double(big.mark = " ", digits = 2) |>
  fontsize(size = 5, part = "all") |>
  set_table_properties(width = 0.25, layout = "autofit") |>
  padding(padding = 3) |>
  delete_part("footer")
```

### Tilbake til long-format

```{r}
#| label: long

  pivot_longer(
    cols = k1103_Stavanger:k0000_TotaltBo,
    names_to = c("akom", "akom_navn"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "andel"
  ) |>
  select(aar, akom, akom_navn, bkom, bkom_navn, andel)

pend_02_25 |>

head(andel_pendle_data_02_25_long)
```

## Bo- og arbeidsmarkedsregioner NIBR/TØI 2020

```{r}
#| label: ba-reg
ba49 <- paste0("k", c(1103, 1108, 1124, 1127, 1120, 1122, 1121, 1119, 1144, 1130))
ba50 <- paste0("k", c(1106, 1146, 1149, 4612, 1145))
ba51 <- "k1133"
ba52 <- "k1134"
ba53 <- "k1135"
ba55 <- c("k1160", "k4611")

ba_region <- function(k, prefiks) {
  case_when(
    k %in% ba49 ~ paste0(prefiks, "49"),
    k %in% ba50 ~ paste0(prefiks, "50"),
    k %in% ba51 ~ paste0(prefiks, "51"),
    k %in% ba52 ~ paste0(prefiks, "52"),
    k %in% ba53 ~ paste0(prefiks, "53"),
    k %in% ba55 ~ paste0(prefiks, "55"),
    TRUE ~ paste0(prefiks, "99")
  )
}

pend_ba <- pend_02_25 |>
  mutate(
    ba_reg_bo  = ba_region(bkom, "bo"),
    ba_reg_arb = ba_region(akom, "arb")
  )

pend_ba |>
  filter(aar == "2010") |>
  group_by(ba_reg_bo, ba_reg_arb) |>
  summarise(pendlere = sum(pendlere), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ba_reg_arb, values_from = pendlere)
```
